title: Load a printed page into a clear sheet protector
instruction: Put the loose printed page all the way inside the clear sheet protector. Leave the page flat inside and take both grippers away.
context: Filing a handout in a clear binder pocket is a familiar office and classroom task. Opening the thin film while keeping both corners of a flexible page aligned prevents the sheet from catching, buckling or landing on top.
setup: Use the standard YAM table (747.5 mm high), an open blue three-ring binder (~284 × 500 mm) with 9 mm of filed paper, an unmodified 24° book rest, and a clear top-loading Letter polypropylene protector such as Avery 75540. The model pocket is 289 × 222 mm inside with a reinforced ring margin. Its mouth is at X 481, Y 5 and Z 888 mm in the station frame, facing the arms. Place a loose printed Letter sheet (279.4 × 215.9 mm, 120 g/m²) on a separate roughly 266 × 226 mm plastic document stand at the same angle, trailing edge at X 207, Y −240 and Z 969 mm with a 22 mm overhang. The sheet is wholly outside the pocket. Open both grippers.
scoring: 1.0 if the page is entirely inside and beneath the film, both leading corners within 9 mm of the bottom seam, the sheet within 6 mm of flat, the mouth closed to within 5.5 mm of its flat position and both grippers at least 35 mm clear for 0.45 s. 0.5 if the leading third is inside and beneath the film and the page is released and still with both grippers clear. 0.0 otherwise, including a sheet on top of the film. Check with a ruler and photos or video.
reset_notes: Remove the filed sheet. Replace if creased. Restore the marked stand, binder and loose sheet positions, close the sleeve and open both grippers.
fidelity: Full-size paper and polypropylene sleeve. Three elastic native-contact paper panels sag and buckle lengthwise. A passive flexure opens the film, with bonded-side contact envelopes. The 0.15 mm paper and 0.10 mm film use 0.54 and 0.55 mm collision skins. The 9 mm lip overhang and spring rates are model estimates.
scores: Native scripted demo: 1.0 after 581 actions (29.05 s). Dream-1: 0 after 760 actions.
